question: Should v0.38.4 land through this branch, which already contains the complete proven fix from the overlapping PR, or should the fix PR land first and this branch be rebased to release-only metadata?
rationale: The code does not require repair, but selecting the release version and authoritative landing branch is a release-owner decision that automation should not infer.

options.title: Land this release branch
options.body: Approve v0.38.4 inclusion, merge this branch as the single landing path, and close the overlapping fix PR afterward.

options.title: Land the fix separately
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 first, then rebase this branch so it contains only the approved release metadata.

options.title: Defer v0.38.4
options.body: Keep both branches unmerged until the next release scope and serialization order are explicitly chosen.

recommendation.title: Land this release branch
recommendation.body: Approve v0.38.4 inclusion, merge this branch as the single landing path, and close the overlapping fix PR afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history-backed owner for both the latest release and the release preparation represented by this branch.
